description: This file defines configuration options and validation logic for the Orleans cluster, including default identifiers and a validator class to ensure proper configuration.

classes.name: ClusterOptions
classes.description: Represents configuration options for an Orleans cluster, including cluster and service identifiers with default values.

classes.name: ClusterOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the ClusterOptions instance to ensure required fields are non-empty, throwing exceptions if invalid.

methods.name: ClusterOptionsValidator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the validator with provided options.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if ClusterId and ServiceId are non-empty; throws exceptions if validation fails.
